comment: ANCHOR: CIO_COMPANY_FACTS_SNAPSHOT_1580_20261109 — a company-facts rebuild is serialised per store
and its callers are never queued behind it. 2026-11-09: one module-global lock held across a
579 MB re-parse plus a per-caller deepcopy made /api/v2/cio/pages take 174.7 s and starved
/api/v2/overview past the browser's 30 s abort while the unit sat at memory.high.
